title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: In the figure below, each circle will be filled with a digit from \(1\) to \(6.\) Each digit must appear exactly once. The sum of the digits in neighboring circles is shown in the box between them. What digit must be placed in the top circle?

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: it is impossible to fill the circles

solutions.text: Let the top digit be \(x\). Moving clockwise from the top, the other digits are \(9-x\), \(x-2\), \(7-x\), \(x+1\), and \(6-x\). For these six values to be exactly \(1,2,3,4,5,6\), the value \(x=5\) works and gives the set \(5,4,3,2,6,1\). Thus the top digit is \(5\).
hints: The two adjacent upper digits are \(9-x\) and \(6-x\)
